title: ena mori wins at Taiwan's Golden Indie Music Awards
summary: Filipino-Japanese artist ena mori clinched the Best Asian Creative Artist award at the recent Golden Indie Music Awards (GIMA), highlighting her artistic excellence in Asia's independent music scene.
